page.description: A predictable annual license. Your data stays yours.
page.usageHelp: Certificates and keys are not counted.
page.rule1: Review the customer, validity period and target limit before activation.
page.rule2: Annual licenses keep full operation during the grace period. Evaluation licenses have no grace period.
page.rule3: Lock mode does not delete keys or revoke certificates. In-flight changes finish or roll back safely.
page.lockedText: Inventory, exports, the audit trail and backups remain available. Renew the license to resume changes.
page.graceText: Full operation continues until {{date}}. Then external changes pause; inventory, exports, the audit trail and backups stay available.
page.evaluationText: An evaluation has no grace period: when it ends, external changes pause until a signed license is uploaded.

banner.evaluation_one: Evaluation mode: {{count}} day left, up to {{max_targets}} targets. To continue after that, an administrator adds a license on the License page.
banner.evaluation_other: Evaluation mode: {{count}} days left, up to {{max_targets}} targets. To continue after that, an administrator adds a license on the License page.
banner.evaluation_ended: The evaluation period has ended. Alice is now read-only for changes. Administrators can upload a license on the License page.
banner.expiry_warning_one: Your license expires in {{count}} day ({{valid_until}}). Send your Installation ID to your vendor to renew.
banner.expiry_warning_other: Your license expires in {{count}} days ({{valid_until}}). Send your Installation ID to your vendor to renew.
banner.grace: Your license expired on {{valid_until}}. Alice will stop automatic work on {{locks_at}} (168 hours after expiry). Contact your vendor now. Grace day {{grace_day}} of 7.
banner.locked: License expired. Automatic tasks are paused. Your data is safe and certificate expiry alerts still arrive by email. Administrators: upload a new license on the License page.
banner.tampered: License data was changed outside Alice, so Alice ignores the changed file. Upload the license file from your vendor again.
banner.clock_behind: The server clock changed unexpectedly (it says {{system_time}}, but Alice last saw {{last_seen}}). Alice is using the later date for license checks. Please correct the server time or contact your vendor.
banner.clock_jump_one: The server clock jumped forward by {{count}} day. For 24 hours Alice keeps using the previous time for license checks. Confirm the time is correct, or contact your vendor.
banner.clock_jump_other: The server clock jumped forward by {{count}} days. For 24 hours Alice keeps using the previous time for license checks. Confirm the time is correct, or contact your vendor.
banner.pending: A new license ({{license_id}}) starts on {{valid_from}}. The current license stays in use until then.
banner.over_limit: You use {{used}} of {{max}} licensed targets. You cannot add more until you are within the limit.
banner.limit_reached: You are using all {{max}} licensed targets. To add more, ask your vendor to increase your license.
banner.unverified: Alice could not check its license since {{last_checked}}. Changes to managed systems are paused until the check succeeds. Tasks requested meanwhile wait and start by themselves after the next successful check.

verify.title: Verification settings
verify.help: After a deployment Alice connects to the website and checks that the new certificate is served. Change these only when Alice cannot reach the website directly, for example behind a load balancer.
verify.port: Port to check (empty: the port from the configuration)
verify.sni: Name to check (empty: from the configuration)
verify.skip: Skip the check for this website
verify.skipHelp: Not recommended: a wrong certificate would not be noticed or restored automatically.
verify.readOnly: Only an administrator can change these settings.
verify.portInvalid: Enter a port from 1 to 65535, or leave the field empty.
verify.sniIp: Enter a domain name, not an IP address.
verify.sniWildcard: Enter one domain name without a wildcard (*).
verify.sniInvalid: Enter a domain name with letters, digits, dots and hyphens only. A part between dots cannot start or end with a hyphen.
verify.notSaved: Your change was not saved because this website changed in the meantime. The current values are shown now. Check them and save again.

deploy.title: Deploy a certificate
deploy.noCandidates: Alice holds no certificate with a private key that fits this website. Upload one first.
deploy.summary: Alice backs up the current files, writes the new certificate and key, checks the Nginx configuration, reloads Nginx and checks that the new certificate is served. If any step fails, Alice restores the previous files.
deploy.confirmChain: I confirm that this incomplete chain is intended
deploy.chainAdminOnly: The chain of this certificate is incomplete. An administrator must deploy it.
deploy.noWebsites: This certificate is not used on any website that Alice can deploy to. Open the server of the website and choose Deploy certificate there.
deploy.notYetValid: This certificate is not valid yet and cannot be deployed.
deploy.limit: You can deploy to at most {{max}} websites at once. Untick some websites.
deploy.refused: Alice stopped here. A request names only the first website that stops it, so other websites may need attention too. Nothing was deployed; fix this website or untick it and try again.
deploy.succeeded: The new certificate is live and verified.
deploy.verifiedLocally: Alice checked it from the server itself because it cannot reach the website directly.
deploy.verifySkipped: The check was skipped for this website, so Alice did not confirm that the new certificate is served.
deploy.unchanged: This certificate was already in place. Nothing was changed.
deploy.rolledBack: Your server was restored to its previous certificate.
deploy.noChange: Nothing was changed on the server.
deploy.rollbackFailed: Alice cannot confirm which certificate the website serves. Manual action is needed.
deploy.recovering: Alice has not yet confirmed how this deployment ended. It is checking the server and will finish or undo the change.
deploy.held: The license has expired, so this deployment is on hold. It continues when an administrator renews the license or runs it.
deploy.jobStopped: The background job ended before the deployment did. Open the deployment history to see where it stands.
deploy.unknownStatus: Alice cannot tell the state of this deployment. Open the deployment history to see it.
deploy.stillWorking: Alice is still working on this. Open the deployment history in a minute to see the result.
deploy.connectionLost: Your browser cannot reach Alice right now. The deployment goes on in the background. Open the deployment history in a minute to see the result.
deploy.succeededUnverified: The new certificate was deployed and Nginx was reloaded.
deploy.rollbackFailedRestored: The previous files are back, but Alice could not confirm that the website serves the previous certificate. Check the website now.
deploy.finishing: The background job has finished. Alice is recording the result.
deploy.partialOpen: Websites not finished yet: {{open}}. Follow them in the deployment history.
deploy.listCut: The list of certificates was cut after {{count}} entries, so some certificates are not offered here.
deploy.pendingChangeRestored: The new certificate was not written. Alice put back the files from before an unfinished earlier change, so the website now serves the certificate it had before that change. That may not be the certificate it served when you chose Deploy.
deploy.partialUnchanged_one: Websites that already had this certificate: {{count}}
deploy.partialUnchanged_other: Websites that already had this certificate: {{count}}
deploy.serverOperationPending: The new certificate was not written. An unfinished earlier change on the server blocks these files; see below.

recovery.confirmed_other: Alice confirmed the outcome after {{count}} recovery attempts.

rotation.title: Automatic rotation
rotation.none: No rotation policy. Alice changes this key only when you ask.
rotation.name: Name
rotation.overlapHelp: Both keys work during this time, so people and systems can switch to the new key.
rotation.offHelp: The policy is off. Alice plans no run until you switch it on.

rotation.editSwitchesOff: Changing the interval, the overlap, the notice time or the new key type of a policy that is on switches it off, and a planned run that has not started is cancelled. Afterwards, switch it on again; that needs your authenticator code.

invalid.name: Enter a name of 1 to 100 characters.

rotation.previewing: Alice is planning the next run.
rotation.previewIntro: Alice will add a new key next to the old one in these places, check that it works, keep both keys for the overlap, then remove the old key.
rotation.previewEmailed: Alice is emailing this preview to the administrators.
rotation.previewNotEmailed: This preview was not emailed: an email about this key was sent in the last 10 minutes, or email is not set up.
rotation.previewRefreshed: The plan changed since you looked at it, so nothing was started. The preview below is the new one. Check it, then choose Run now again.
rotation.nothingToChange: No place would change, so there is nothing to rotate.
rotation.noLoginTest: Alice cannot test a login here
rotation.decisionDue: Decide before {{date}}, or Alice undoes the rotation.
rotation.pausedBanner: Paused: the license expired or could not be checked. Alice adds no new key and removes no old key for this rotation until the license is valid again and you choose Continue.
rotation.continueHelp: Alice goes on where it stopped. Before it removes any old key it tests the new key again.
rotation.finishNowHelp: Alice ends the overlap now and emails the administrators. In each place it tests the new key once more and removes the old key only where the new key works; places where the old key is kept are not touched.
rotation.keepOld: Keep the old key on these servers
rotation.keepOldHelp: Alice could not test the new key in these places. Tick the places where the old key stays; Alice never removes it there, nor from other places in the same file. At least one place where the new key works must remain. When no untested place is left, the overlap begins; if untested places are left at the deadline, Alice undoes the whole rotation.
rotation.abortConfirm: Stop the rotation and remove the new key where Alice added it? The old key stays.
rotation.keptCount: Places where the old key stays: {{count}}
rotation.keptHelp: The old key stays in the places below shown as Skipped, Not started, Old key kept or Old key not removed. In some of them Alice never added the new key: before you remove the old key from one of these places yourself, make sure the new key works there.
